Skip tracks with the triggers.

- In Music (VLM), R2 skips to the next track and L2 goes back. This works for your files and for Spotify and other apps.
- R1 / L1 now turn automatic effect changes on and off.
- Prefer the old layout? Settings (or the menu) > Skip tracks with > Shoulders (R1 / L1) swaps them back.
- Triggers work whether your controller sends them as buttons or as analog triggers.
